scenario.title: Product Archive: 200,000 Deep Faceted Price Page
scenario.codePath: shop page with price and attribute filters
scenario.trigger: Deep catalog page over 200,000 products with price ordering and a global attribute filter.

slow_queries.sql: SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS wp_posts.ID FROM wp_posts LEFT JOIN wp_wc_product_meta_lookup wc_product_meta_lookup ON wp_posts.ID = wc_product_meta_lookup.product_id WHERE 1=1 AND ( wp_posts.ID NOT IN ( SELECT object_id FROM wp_term_relationships WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN (7) ) ) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'product' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wp_term_relationships tr INNER JOIN wp_term_taxonomy tt ON tr.term_taxonomy_id = tt.term_taxonomy_id WHERE tr.object_id = wp_posts.ID AND tt.taxonomy = 'pa_path_size' AND tt.term_id IN (217) )) AND NOT (120.000000<wc_product_meta_lookup.min_price OR 10.000000>wc_product_meta_lookup.max_price ) GROUP BY wp_posts.ID ORDER BY wc_product_meta_lookup.min_price ASC, wc_product_meta_lookup.product_id ASC LIMIT 0, 16
